claim: On Application Load Balancers and Network Load Balancers, the load balancer starts routing to a newly registered target as soon as registration completes and the target passes the first initial health check, irrespective of the configured threshold.

qualifiers.scope: newly registered target, Application and Network Load Balancers

evidence.quote: The load balancer starts routing traffic to a newly registered target as soon as the registration process completes and the target passes the first initial health check, irrespective of the configured threshold.
